cases.boundary: Capture waits for HTTP completion, finalization wins over late cancellation, and active capture overflow produces an explicit bounded audit outcome.
guarantees: A cancelled capture cannot be resurrected by a late HTTP completion.
A finalized capture releases its active reservation exactly once.
Oversized active capture is represented as overflow rather than silently persisting the body.

cases.boundary: The ingest worker local audit queue is bounded and records overflow drops instead of growing without limit.
guarantees: Queue length never exceeds the configured hard item limit.
An over-limit enqueue increments the audit overflow-drop counter.
Shutdown flush remains bounded.

cases.boundary: Server-to-worker transport must retry capacity rejection once with bounded metadata and preserve the audit identity.
guarantees: The fallback keeps audit ID and trace ID while removing body bytes.
Fallback transport is below the server inline budget.
Only a failed fallback is counted as a whole-record overflow drop.

cases.boundary: Redis transport encoding has a hard total-byte budget and reduces oversized payloads to a structured summary.
guarantees: Encoded Redis Stream payload is at most 4 MiB.
Large payload summaries retain SHA-256, source size, and 256 KiB head and tail windows.
Problem-chain success uses the failure body retention budget.

cases.boundary: A batch write skips existing and in-batch duplicate audit IDs while grouping equivalent failures in one five-minute error window.
guarantees: Duplicate audit IDs do not produce attempts or payload references.
Existing IDs are looked up in one batch rather than one query per record.
Equivalent failures increment one error group event count.

cases.boundary: Payload storage deduplicates by content identity, keeps reference counts correct, and returns the original body through bounded window reads.
guarantees: Repeated body content reuses one payload blob and increments ref_count.
Compressed payload can be read back as the original body window.
Blob identity is shared while audit payload references remain distinct.

cases.boundary: Audit retention uses the dedicated policy and deletes blob metadata/files only after no payload reference remains.
guarantees: Success hot retention is distinct from long-term sampled success retention.
Failure retention is distinct from success retention.
Referenced payload blobs survive cleanup and unreferenced candidates are removed.
